executable_actions.on_failure: Keep template_selection blocked and prohibit promotion of the candidate artifact until a valid trust barrier or equivalent stage gate decision is recorded.
executable_actions.rationale: The candidate has a deterministic current-stage parameter-binding failure. A trust barrier prevents downstream stages from consuming unsupported FFN tile bindings or interpreting later-stage implementation absence/presence as template-selection success.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not edit FFN.scala or other template internals; keep the stage blocked and escalate to a stage backtrack request for parameter-binding evidence.
executable_actions.rationale: The passing source/interface and coverage evidence indicate the earliest causal boundary is missing FFN tile parameter binding for the selected ffn template instances, not unsupported operators or missing source files.

executable_actions.on_failure: If no deterministic legal tile values are present in existing SACG/input artifacts, produce no promoted candidate and execute template_selection.request_architecture_tile_backtrack_if_unbound.
executable_actions.rationale: If existing SACG/input design-space facts contain a single legal FFN tile_m, tile_n, and tile_k choice, bind those values explicitly into the template-selection contract. This is a bounded contract repair only; it must not alter numeric policy, memory layout, data order, board facts, or template internals.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the current template-selection artifact blocked and preserve the trust barrier until an approved design-space tile policy is available.
executable_actions.rationale: Selecting or adding FFN tile_m, tile_n, or tile_k values when they are absent from current SACG/input facts is an architecture/design-space decision and requires bounded approval rather than guessing or using defaults.

executable_actions.on_failure: Retain blocked_current_stage status, keep unsupported bindings quarantined, and route the new failed checker evidence back to failure localization without proceeding to code generation or implementation stages.
executable_actions.rationale: After any bounded tile-binding repair or approved backtrack resolution, the stage must rerun deterministic static expectations and produce an updated disposition for coverage, parameter binding, template binding/source-interface expectations, attention semantic expansion, and cross-layer trace before promotion.
